.equ MINUS   = 10
.equ NIC     = 11

.equ P       = 16

.def mig2    =r5

.def rjasnosc=r14

.def powtorz=r11
.def ostatni=r12
.def licznik=r13
.def ostatni_zero =r14
.def dana=r15



.def tmp     =r16

.def HY      =r29

	ldi r30, (@0*2)&255
	ldi r31, @0>>7
.endmacro

.macro lsr16
	lsr @1
	ror @0
.endmacro

.macro adi

.endmacro

	w:            .byte 7
	minusik:      .byte 1
	minusik1:     .byte 1
	minusik2:     .byte 1
	temperatura1: .byte 2
	temperatura2: .byte 2
	czas:
		sek:    .byte 1

	out SPL, tmp
	ldi tmp, 1<<WGM01
	out TCCR0A, tmp
	ldi tmp, (1<<CS00)+(1<<CS01)
	out TCCR0B, tmp
	ldi tmp, (1<<LOAD)+(1<<CLK)+(1<<DIN)
	out DDR595, tmp
	clr ZERO
	sbi PORTD, 0

	sbi PORTA, 1
	rjmp main

	in sregtmp, SREG
	push X
	ldi tmpi, 180	;start rejestru timera
	out TCNT0, tmpi

	sbrs mig1, 1	;obsl. klawiatury
	rcall obsl_przyc

	inc mig1
	brne int_wysylaj
	inc mig2r
	inc mig2

	mov tmpi, mig2r
	andi tmpi, 0x0f
	brne jasnosc_ust

	cp rjasnosc, jasnosc
	breq jasnosc_ust
	brlo jasnosc_mniejsza

	dec rjasnosc
	rjmp jasnosc_ust

	inc rjasnosc

	adi tmpi, 12
	cp mig2, tmpi
	brlo int_wysylaj

	brlo podany_cykl
	inc tryb

	mov rjasnosc, jasnosc

	mov tmpi, mig1	;jasnosc
